scope.list.note: a member's scope: list is a list's name, as the workspace named it

scope.only.note: a key's scope, or a member's with one sender domain: name is a list's name or a domain

scope.parts.note: parts: list names or a count of lists, and sender domains, joined with ' · '

scope.all.note: the scope of a member or key that isn't limited to some lists (the member page's Scope column)

problem.unknownList.note: value: the list ID that was sent

problem.unknownDomain.note: value: the domain that was sent

cantGrant.message: You can't grant {permission} because you don't hold it.
cantGrant.note: permission: a key like segments:sql, never translated

cantGrantAsk.message: You can't grant {permission} because you don't hold it. Ask {helpers}.
cantGrantAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

notHoldable.ai: AI features are for people. Agents bring their own model.
notHoldable.peopleOnly: Only people can hold {permission}: API keys and agents can't.
notHoldable.verify: Not offered to agents: it sends addresses out of ReputeCast
notHoldable.placementRun: Not offered to agents: it sends copies through your providers
notHoldable.placementManage: Not offered to agents: seed passwords and tokens can read whole mailboxes
notHoldable.agents: MCP agents can't hold {permission}. Give it to an API key or a person.

problem.audienceScope.message: Your access is limited to some lists: send only to those lists, not to other lists or a segment.
problem.audienceScope.note: a member whose role is scoped to some lists tried to send to an audience reaching other contacts
